interpretation: Finite discrete state sampling only. It is not strict continuous collision detection and does not certify the swept volume between samples.

implementations.joint_interpolation_criterion: delta = nearest_equivalent_joint_positions(q_target, q_source) - q_source; max_step_deg = rad2deg(max(abs(delta))); reject before collision checks if max_step_deg > max_joint_step_deg + 1e-9.
implementations.cartesian_tcp_interpolation_criterion: none; only joint vectors are interpolated and passed to the collision callback.
implementations.sample_parameterization: np.linspace(0.0, 1.0, count); q(alpha) = q0 + alpha * delta
implementations.collision_refinement_rule: stop at the first sampled colliding state; record first_collision_alpha and callback summary
implementations.termination_condition: all finite samples pass, or first collision, or the transition is rejected by node/formal/joint-step gate
implementations.stage3_claim: This implementation is the graph transition semantics; it is not a continuous collision checker.

implementations.joint_interpolation_criterion: For each selected trajectory-point pair, segment_steps = max(1, ceil(max(abs(end_positions - start_positions)) / max_step_rad)).
implementations.cartesian_tcp_interpolation_criterion: none; no TCP/Cartesian subdivision criterion is implemented in this collision function.
implementations.segment_sample_count: segment_steps start-inclusive samples per pair plus one final trajectory endpoint; adjacent pairs share endpoint states.
implementations.sample_parameterization: q(alpha) = start + alpha * (end-start), alpha = local_index / segment_steps for local_index in [0, segment_steps-1]; final endpoint appended explicitly
implementations.collision_refinement_rule: No recursive refinement; collision is recorded for any sampled state and validation raises on the first failing set after the scan.
implementations.termination_condition: all generated samples checked, or the function raises after the collision scan if any collision was recorded
implementations.stage3_claim: This is the historical post-Ruckig validator semantics and remains discrete.

implementations.joint_interpolation_criterion: segment_steps = max(1, ceil(abs(q1_j-q0_j)/max_step_rad)) over all joints.
implementations.cartesian_tcp_interpolation_criterion: none in the native collision edge loop.
implementations.collision_refinement_rule: none beyond the finite sample set; collision samples are retained in the native audit output
implementations.termination_condition: all samples in the finite edge set are checked

numerical_tolerance.step_floor: max_step_rad is derived from configured interpolation_step_deg; no recursive geometric tolerance

implementations.stage3_claim: This source is retained as a native Stage 2 evidence implementation and is not silently upgraded to CCD.

forbidden_claims: minimum clearance certified from collision-free states
provenance_policy: Source SHA256 values are checked by the H1 gate at run time. Any source change requires a new contract review and gate run.
